description: This Python module provides a comprehensive subtitle correction pipeline, including text normalization, grammar and style corrections, OTT compliance enforcement, and optional audio or transcript-based harmonization processes. It integrates various optional dependencies (like language_tool_python, textstat, whisper, and faster-whisper) to enhance subtitle quality through multiple correction layers, handling subtitle cues, and optionally leveraging speech recognition outputs.

methods.name: bool _is_nan_value(value: Any)
methods.description: Internal helper to detect NaN values across types safely.

methods.name: List[Dict] correct_subtitles_pipeline( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", enable_grammar: bool = True, enable_ott_rules: bool = True, enable_audio_correction: bool = False, audio_source: Optional[str] = None, asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, transcript: Optional[List[Dict]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function orchestrating subtitle text normalization, correction, OTT compliance, and optional audio/transcript correction.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: Any)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace, punctuation, and sanitizes input text, accepting any type.

methods.name: None _apply_grammar_and_spell_corrections(cues: List[Dict], language: str = "en")
methods.description: Applies grammar/spell corrections using language_tool_python if available.

methods.name: bool _is_change_reasonable(original: str, corrected: str)
methods.description: Determines if the correction differs significantly from the original text, to avoid unwarranted changes.

methods.name: None _apply_ott_compliance_rules( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", max_lines_per_cue: int = 2, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, enforce_terminal_punctuation: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enforces OTT subtitle standards such as line length, line limits, terminal punctuation, and reading heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Helper to wrap text into lines respecting maximum length and line count.

methods.name: str _adjust_for_reading_speed(text: str)
methods.description: Rewraps text based on reading speed heuristics when textstat is available.

methods.name: None _apply_transcript_timing_and_text_corrections( cues: List[Dict], transcript: List[Dict], *, timing_snap_threshold: float = 0.75, prefer_transcript_if_score_gap: int = 15, )
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle cues based on transcript segments for timing and text alignment.

methods.name: List[Dict] _normalize_transcript_segments(transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts transcript data to a normalized list of segments with start/end times and text.

methods.name: None _apply_audio_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], *, audio_source: Optional[str], language: str = "en", asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Performs ASR transcription on provided audio/video and harmonizes subtitle text accordingly.

methods.name: List[Dict] _run_asr( audio_source: str, *, language: str, model_name: Optional[str], device: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Executes ASR transcription using available libraries 'faster-whisper' or 'whisper.'

methods.name: str _collect_asr_text_for_window(segments: List[Dict], start: float, end: float)
methods.description: Concatenates ASR text segments overlapping a specified cue window.

methods.name: bool _overlaps(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
methods.description: Checks if two time intervals overlap.

methods.name: float _timestamp_to_seconds(ts: str)
methods.description: Converts timestamp string 'HH:MM:SS,mmm' to seconds as float.

methods.name: str _seconds_to_timestamp(seconds: float)
methods.description: Converts seconds as float to timestamp string 'HH:MM:SS,mmm'.

methods.name: str _harmonize_text_with_asr(sub_text: Any, asr_text: Any)
methods.description: Attempts to harmonize subtitle text with ASR output tokens through fuzzy matching.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: Any)
methods.description: Splits input text into tokens (words and punctuation).

methods.name: str _detokenize(tokens: List[str])
